activity_summary: At home you wrote the three numbers he will ask, five and six and ten, and you did not write the five words themselves. You had not answered. You went to play Egeon with the page still a question.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the numbers, and refused the page the decision.
